notes.content: A wholly handwritten English letter, dated at Voorschoten, reports the dispatch of a manuscript on the tame fundamental group and borrowed papers (opening paragraph). It asks about scheme/prescheme and doublet terminology (paragraph 2), explains the cited EGA/SGA numbering (References paragraph), and gives comments keyed to manuscript pages 3, 5 and 6. The last comment distinguishes the word covering as a translation of revêtement from covering in a topology, and continues beyond this sheet after what. The margin has a sloping stroke label and line, SGA 1, a circled O.K-, and a lower O.K. Authorship and the annotating hands are not identified from outside sources.
